evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general? -- asked late, after the customer had already walked through his full itemized list.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Do you think that would be the kind of thing that fits within one moving then and both my wife and I would be assisting the crew...? -- rep answered once with a caveat about box count, no deeper follow-up beyond that clarification.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: once we are over the minimum the time is for rated in fifteen minute increments

top_strength: Smart initial offer of a virtual walkthrough for the 2100 sq ft home, then adapted cleanly when the customer pushed back with his own itemized list -- correctly right-sized the crew (2 movers/1 truck instead of the typical 4/2) based on what he was actually moving.
coaching_note: No explicit ask to book was ever made -- the call ended with instructions on how to book later by email/callback rather than a direct 'would you like me to get you on the schedule' question.
